samples: This program prints a simple plain-text invoice statement for two sample customers, showing each customer name, how many line items they have, and the invoice total in fixed-width columns. It also prints the grand total across both invoices. The imported invoice module computes totals by summing line items, applying a percentage discount, and rounding to cents, so this is useful if you want a small reporting tool for displaying invoice summaries rather than a full billing system.

This program prints a simple plain-text invoice statement for two sample orders, showing each customer, how many line items they have, and the invoice total in fixed-width columns. It sorts the sample invoices by customer name before printing them, then prints a final grand total across both invoices. It depends on the `invoice` module’s discount-aware total calculation, so it is useful if you want a small reporting script rather than a full invoicing system.

This program prints a simple plain-text statement for two sample invoices, showing each customer name, how many line items they have, and the invoice total in fixed-width columns. It sorts the invoices by customer name before printing, then prints a final grand total for both invoices combined. It is useful if you want a small reporting tool for invoice summaries, but it is hardcoded to sample data rather than reading real invoices from input.

It also prints the combined grand total of both invoices. The imported invoice module computes totals by summing line amounts, applying a percentage discount, and rounding to cents, so this is useful if you want a small reporting tool for displaying invoice summaries rather than generating files or doing interactive input.
